subject: geography
summary: Short-answer cards with a definite answer look clean (28 years, South east, the rock table), and the volcano card with the question diagram plus the scheme's labelled diagram is the best thing in the sample. But many cards cannot be answered from the card itself: the stem says 'the graph above', 'the map above' or 'the features below' while the graph, map or table lives only behind an attachment button, and that attachment is a whole exam page showing other parts and sometimes a different question. Several schemes contain no answer at all ('The scheme prints no answer here: any correct one earns the marks'), including the 30-mark essay and the 20-mark sketch map, which leaves only counters and mark buttons. The whole OS map is shown at a size where nothing can be read, and scheme rows carry shorthand and stray characters ('6//', '7/6 and 6/7 SRPs', 'Four answers @ 5 marks each').

issues.title: Question refers to a figure that is not on the card
issues.detail: Stems say 'Examine the graph above' (cards 1, 11), 'Study the map above' (card 7), 'Match each of the features below ... in the table below' (card 6) and 'Complete the table below' (card 4), but nothing is above or below: the graph/map/table is only behind the 'Official question page' button. Card 6 is the worst case: the text never names the features or the lettered processes, so the question is meaningless without opening the page, and the page as it opens shows Question 2 first.
issues.suggested_fix: Show a tight crop of the graph/map/table inline in the question area (as cards 9 and 10 do) and keep the full page as a secondary link. For card 6 show the lettered pictures/table inline.

issues.title: Attached page shows other parts and a different question
issues.detail: The attachment is the full exam page. Card 6 (Q3) opens on all of Q2 'Rocks' (both parts) with Q3 only starting at the bottom edge; card 10 (Q4) opens on all of Q3 'Regions' with Q4's diagram cut off below the fold. Cards 1, 7 and 11 show the graph/map plus the sibling parts (i), (ii) of the same question.
issues.suggested_fix: Crop the attachment to this question's figure/table only; never open on a neighbouring question.

issues.title: Scheme shows no answer, only a mark counter
issues.detail: Card 7 ('Name any one country in the 0-9 category') reveals 'Country named - The scheme prints no answer here: any correct one earns the marks'; card 8 gives 'Location 1 / Location 2' with the same line; card 2's sketch map is four rows of 1m-6m buttons with that line repeated; card 3 (30-mark essay) and card 12 (12 marks) are just '+/-' SRP counters. The student learns the mark split but nothing about what a correct answer looks like, and cannot self-check.
issues.suggested_fix: Where the scheme prints sample answers or 'e.g.' lists, show them as examples. Where it truly prints none, show a crop of the official scheme entry so the student sees that is all there is, and consider offering worked example answers clearly labelled as not from the SEC.

issues.title: Raw examiner shorthand and stray characters in scheme rows
issues.detail: Card 3 has a row titled 'Examination of impact · 6//' and a heading 'Examination of cause and impact (7/6 and 6/7 SRPs)', plus 'Credit 1 x SRP...' and 'Max 7 x SRP's'. Card 1 says 'Four answers @ 5 marks each' above a single 5-mark box on a 5-mark card (that line describes the whole of Q7A, not this part) and the answer is slash-joined 'Increasing / Rising / Growing / Upward'. Card 9 says 'Each question · 4 parts @ 2 marks each' on a 2-mark card and lists 'Clós, Ráth, Lios, Enclosure, Ringfort' as one tick with no 'any one'. Card 10's 'Five terms @ 2 marks each as follows' sits inside the Vent box only. Every row also carries an 'EXACT ALLOCATION · / 2' tag that reads like debug text, and each answer is repeated as box title and tick label (card 6: 'Freeze Thaw Action' / 'Freeze Thaw Action · D').
issues.suggested_fix: Rewrite in plain words ('Any one of: Increasing, Rising, Growing, Upward - 5 marks'; 'Cause: up to 6 points at 2 marks each'), drop whole-question allocation lines from single-part cards, remove '6//' and the EXACT ALLOCATION tags, and do not repeat the answer as its own heading.

issues.title: Matching answers lose their meaning
issues.detail: Card 6's scheme lists 'Freeze Thaw Action · D, River Erosion · A, Chemical Weathering · E...' but the card never shows what features A-E are, so the letters mean nothing. Card 10's five ticks are just the five given terms ('Vent', 'Crater'...), which does not tell the student which blank each goes in; only the scheme diagram does that job.
issues.suggested_fix: Show matches as pairs in a two-column table (feature -> process), and for label-the-diagram questions lead with the scheme's labelled diagram.

issues.title: OS map unreadable at the size shown
issues.detail: The 'Official 1:50 000 map extract' opens as a whole-sheet image about 780px wide in the reader; place names and grid numbers are a few pixels high and cannot be read on desktop, let alone a 390px phone. Card 5 needs the student to find Long Hill and Lachtnafrankee on it. Card 9 handles this far better with an inline crop of the relevant grid squares.
issues.suggested_fix: Give every OS map card an inline crop of the relevant squares like card 9, and open the full map at a zoomable size with pinch/drag.

issues.title: Options and lists flattened
issues.detail: Card 5's tick-box options appear as two bare lines 'North east' / 'South east' with no boxes. Card 4's six terms (a 2x3 grid on the paper) run as six plain lines indistinguishable from the question text around them, and the answer table (Limestone/Shale/Sandstone) is only in the attachment. Card 12's stem starts '(i) Name one example...' then jumps to '(iii)', with (ii) missing and no explanation that (i) is context.
issues.suggested_fix: Render options as chips/tick boxes, the term list as a boxed word bank, and show the answer table as a real table.

issues.title: Scheme diagram placed in the question column; phone gaps
issues.detail: On card 10 the scheme's labelled diagram appears after reveal under the question on the left, away from 'The Scheme' heading on the right, and in grey rather than colour; on phone both diagrams are small (labels roughly 6-7px) and need Enlarge. Most phone cards also have a 200-400px blank band before 'Your answer'.
issues.suggested_fix: Put the labelled diagram at the top of the scheme panel and let diagrams fill the phone width; remove the blank band.

good_examples.why: Question shown as a crop of the real diagram, and the reveal adds the scheme's labelled diagram - immediately checkable.
Inline map crop of the right grid squares is large and legible, and the guide explains honestly that no legend was published.
Simple question with one unmistakable answer (28 years); clean on phone apart from the graph being behind a button.
